body:
## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `9b6e4da77eda73a8ad2b784c4a01522c49574e34`
Local-runs: none
Scope: docs/adr/0131-total-organization-ownership-no-null-organization-id.md, plus files read to judge it

Read-only. Fetched `origin/claude/issue-24897-adr-0131-dated-notes` (head `9b6e4da77e`, merge-base = `origin/main` `459afea1f6`) and its diff against main (one file, +176/-26, two commits `9b2ae461e8` and `9b6e4da77e`). Read the ADR whole on both sides. Read every cited record from the GitHub API: the two in-flight rulings `6328195425` (#25134) and `6328987873` (#25133), the #25134 card body, the #24583 close record `6323222024`, execution record `6285122667`, reports `6284717698` and `6288405082`, the 7b-3 claim amendment `6284744613`, the publish record `6291577585` (#15194), the #24948 ruling `6303358360`, the #24883 seat decision `6324268472`, the #25140 seat ACCEPT `6325596117`, the #24825 contract review `6287357347`, the #24919 measurement `6323585273`, the step-4 ruling `6278609968`, the #24378 ruling `6258883445`, the 7a-2 landing record `6294524149`, the #24897 card, claim `6329368843` and dev report `6329720915`, the live PR body, and the PR records for #24524, #24667, #24681, #24825, #24828, #24836, #24845, #24872, #24880, #24893, #24911, #24940, #25016, #25140, #25141, #24428, #24599. Checked every cited merge commit for existence on `origin/main` and for ancestry against the 18.0.0 version commit `06cab4849a`. Read the code the notes name on `origin/main` with `git show` and `git grep` (core, objectql, driver-sql, driver-turso, driver-memory, plugin-sharing, plugin-auth, plugin-audit, service-storage, cli serve, the chokepoint gate, the ceremony's not-null step, the spec contract and migration constants), and the four D7-note objects at `06cab4849a`. Ran the governed-merge check and three node-builtin ADR gates in a detached scratchpad worktree of the head (removed afterwards). Built nothing, posted nothing.

### ① Derived judgments

Item 1, the nine notes, each sentence against `origin/main` and its record:

- Note 1, release scope (D14, replaces the 2026-10-19 note): TRUE. `06cab4849a` is `chore: version packages` (#24524), the `@objectstack/*@18.0.0` tags point at it, and `6291577585` records the maintainer's publish. Ancestry against `06cab4849a`: #24667 `fc34d000fc` (step 4), #24681 `12d14765c7` (steps 5+6), 7a-1 `7c2eab929c`, 7a-3 `7cacad5348`, 7b-3 `df8bb40a03`, 7c `bd6dab0091` are IN 18.0.0; 7a-2 `94842bad2a`, 7b-0 `5e9b100743`, 7b-1+7b-2 `d5d8146012`, 7z `0091d845e2` are AFTER it, exactly as items 1 and 2 say. `6323222024` (2026-10-21T18:15Z) is the close record whose table lists every part with PR and merge commit, and it states the four invariants the note repeats. Item 3: at `06cab4849a`, `packages/platform-objects/src/audit/sys-identity-email.object.ts:46`, `packages/platform-objects/src/system/sys-platform-setting-audit.object.ts:48`, `packages/platform-objects/src/system/sys-secret.object.ts:49` and `packages/services/service-automation/src/sys-flow-credential.object.ts:54` each declare `systemFields: { tenant: false }`, and `packages/plugins/plugin-webhooks/src/auto-enqueuer.ts:573-574` marks declared subscriptions `deploymentWide`. Item 4: `ORGANIZATION_OWNERSHIP_SHAPE_GENERATION = 1` at `packages/spec/src/system/migration.zod.ts:215`; `6291577585` sets the no-bump constraint and the pin requirement. The pin sentence is TRUE for 7b-0 and 7b-1+7b-2 (their PR bodies show the fixture-18.0.0 leg green and the live boot measured); for 7a-2 the pin is #24911's harness leg (`81e6edd463`, an ancestor of `94842bad2a`, merged 37 minutes before it), not one 7a-2 added or reported running (its body reports the 12-test harness on `a62067ad4`, before #24911); `6323222024` records that the leg held on every merge. See B3. The closing paragraph reading scope-note items 1 to 3 against items 1 and 4 is TRUE (step 4 carried the walled half of 8b and the walled lift; an 18.0.0-born store is certified at birth per `organization-ownership-boot-guard.ts:545` as `6323585273` reports).
- Note 2, D9 lean-embedding exception: TRUE, with boundary 2 correctly marked in flight. `resolveSystemWriteOrganization` answers `{ kind: 'no-organization-object' }` when the organization object is not registered (`packages/core/src/security/system-write-organization.ts:119-123`); `Engine.resolveSystemInsertOrganization` returns `undefined` on that kind (`packages/objectql/src/engine.ts:7784`), so nothing is stamped. The counter keeps `GLOBAL_TENANT` (`__global__`) only while `organizationObjectRegistered` is false and otherwise throws `OrganizationlessCounterRefusal` (`packages/drivers/driver-sql/src/sql-driver.ts:7970-7973`; code `ERR_SYSTEM_WRITE_ORGANIZATION_REQUIRED` at `organizationless-counter-refusal.ts:41`), which is 7b-3 (#24845 `df8bb40a03`) and matches `6284744613` ("A lean embedding with no organization object keeps `__global__` as its bucket"). Boundary 1: 7b-0's diff passes `tenantColumn` only at the two CREATE TABLE sites (`initObjects` create branch, `ensureShardTable`) and the Turso remote `buildCreateTableSQL`, never ADD COLUMN. Boundary 2: 7b-3's no-secret refusal is `serve.ts:4688` and A1's no-auth refusal is `serve.ts:4666`, both gated on `flags.server`, both offering `--no-server` (`:4672`, `:4696`); `host-kernel` warns only (`serve.ts:4160`). The note's statement of what ruling `6328987873` letter A binds (every production boot without `--dev`, tier off with no `AuthPlugin` or tier on with no secret, refused whether or not `--server`; the texts drop `--no-server`; `host-kernel` keeps warn-only; migrate-and-exit is such a boot; B and C not taken) matches the ruling word for word in substance. `6284744613` is on #24583 and applies rule A1 of #3963 as cited; `6284717698` and `6288405082` are #24583's 7b-3 reports.
- Note 3, D1: TRUE. See item 2 below for the amendment. The 7b-0 note: `5e9b100743` makes the tenant column NOT NULL at CREATE TABLE in driver-sql and the Turso remote face with no metadata change (`6285122667` item 1; the PR's own body); the in-memory driver declares no NOT NULL (`packages/drivers/driver-memory/src/memory-driver.ts:476`; #25141's body says the same); the ceremony reports a pre-7b-0 shard and the Turso remote face as `unsupported` (`packages/cli/src/utils/organization-ownership-not-null.ts:27-31, :45-57`; `turso-driver.ts` `driftApplyLimit`). The measurement sentences match `6323585273` section 1 exactly: 65 of 66, 4, 4, 1 of 64 (`sys_sso_provider`), 0 NULL rows, on `d5d8146012`, the same under all three postures. `sys_sso_provider` declares `tenancy: { enabled: false }` and a plain `organization_id: Field.text` (`packages/platform-objects/src/identity/sys-sso-provider.object.ts:59, :331`), so it is not a tenant column.
- Note 4, D2 `deploymentWide`: TRUE. `SharingRuleRow.deploymentWide?: true` on the spec contract (`packages/spec/src/contracts/sharing-service.ts:481-507`), read by `isDeploymentWideSharingRule` (`packages/plugins/plugin-sharing/src/sharing-rule-service.ts:178-179`); `6285122667` item 2 records the shape and the Default-Organization projection not taken; `6278609968` is step 4's ruling A (on #24580); 7a-3 is #24828 `7cacad5348` (the `criteriaContext` part per `6323222024`'s table); #25140 `60b42cd0b7` retired the "null = global" help in four locales (`6325596117`).
- Note 5, D8 gate: TRUE. 7z is #24880 `0091d845e2`; `scripts/check-tenant-chokepoint.mjs:129-137` lists the refused spellings and the `IS NOT NULL` exemption, `NULL_CALLS` at `:309`, the literal-`'is not'` test at `:318-323`; the self-test region carries cases for `whereNull`, `orWhereNull`, `andWhereNull`, `where`/`orWhere`/`andWhere` with a null comparand, the object form (`orWhere({ [f]: null })`), raw `IS NULL`, and the `'is not'` exemption. #25140 `60b42cd0b7` is the `'is not'` alignment; R1 of `6287357347` is the missing refusal as cited.
- Note 6, D7 `sys_audit_log.tenant_id`: TRUE. `packages/plugins/plugin-audit/src/objects/sys-audit-log.object.ts:31` (`systemFields: { tenant: false }`), `:420` (`tenant_id` lookup); `ATTRIBUTION_PARTITION_COLUMNS = { sys_audit_log: 'tenant_id' }` at `packages/objectql/src/lifecycle/lifecycle-service.ts:240`, `nullIsLive: true` only on the attribution partition and `false` on `organization_id` (`:1628-1637`); judgment 3 of `6287357347` says exactly this; 7a-1 is #24825 `7c2eab929c`.
- Note 7, D5 last-admin guard: TRUE. `grantAnchorsPlatformStanding` (`packages/core/src/security/resolve-authz-context.ts:943-949`) returns false under a wall or with no Default Organization and otherwise requires the grant's owner to be the Default Organization; 7a-2 is #24872 `94842bad2a`; #25141 `abc25a3536` brought `anchorOwnerTest` (`packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/last-admin-guard.ts:1054-1067`) and the bootstrap's grant read (`ensure-default-organization.ts:508`) to that rule; the two fail-open compositions and "only fail-open" are `6324268472`'s measured findings and #25141's body.
- Note 8, `organizationOutOfWriteReach` residue: TRUE in substance. The function is at `packages/services/service-storage/src/metadata-store.ts:797-808` and answers `null` ("in reach") for a row with no organization; the comment "a row stamped with no organization stays in reach" sits at `storage-routes.ts:761`, above `requireStartingOrganization` (`:772`); `6325596117` Q1 letter A kept it. Two precision points, see B2.
- Note 9, organization delete under ruling B: TRUE. `6303358360` is letter B on #24948 (「24948 同意」); #25016 `688052e147` adds `organizationPredicateDeleteRefusal` and `refuseOrganizationDeleteWhileOwned` in `engine.ts` (409 `DELETE_RESTRICTED`, per-table counts, before the walk cascades or clears; a predicate delete refused outright), the auth door's `hooks.before` refusal ahead of the vendor handler, `ORGANIZATION_AUTH_STRUCTURE` (`sys_member`, `sys_invitation`, `sys_team`, `sys_team_member`, `organization_admin` grants), `outlivesOrganization` for `append-only` and `engine-owned` rows kept with their reference and not counted, and pointers (`sys_session.active_organization_id`, `sys_api_key.active_organization_id`, `sys_organization.parent_organization_id`) keeping `set_null`. Each sentence of the note is in that PR's body and diff.

Item 2, amended D1: MATCHES. The paragraph under 「A 让 D1 变成的样子」 in #25134's card is a byte-exact prefix of the new D1; the only addition is the original's middle sentence ("An object whose rows belong to no organization declares … and has **no column**."), kept verbatim. Ruling `6328195425` item 3 adopts that paragraph for #24897. The Amended note quotes the 2026-09-04 text's head and tail exactly as `origin/main` holds them, eliding precisely the sentence that was kept; the decision is stated unchanged. Its bindings 1, 2 and 3 are ruling items 1, 2 and 5 without change of meaning (item 4, the shard sentences, is code and rightly omitted); item 2 is marked "#25134's execution, in flight", as the ruling dispatches it after #25133.

Item 3, D6 regime C: STALE on `origin/main`, in text this PR does not edit (non-blocking, see B1). The sentence "This is a ruled decision that #24421 builds; it has not shipped." is false now: PR #24428 `964a23700f` (merged 2026-10-19T05:27Z, an ancestor of `06cab4849a`, so in 18.0.0) landed `sharing_rule` under regime C, with `SHARING_RULE_ACTIVATION_TYPE = 'sharing_rule'` (`sharing-rule-service.ts:67`), same-name shadowing retired (`:242`, `:977`), and the ceremony migrating a same-name copy to a clone (`packages/cli/src/utils/organization-ownership-apply.ts:119`); #24599 `1e8b6284c0` (also in 18.0.0) closed the `/meta` authoring door. Card #24421 is still open, which is why the note still names it: it was filed for the superseded B′ shape. The true sentence: "This decision shipped in 18.0.0: #24428 (`964a23700f`) added the `sharing_rule` activation type and the same-name refusal, #24599 (`1e8b6284c0`) closed the `/meta` door, and the D10 ceremony's clone migration is in `organization-ownership-apply.ts`."

Item 4, consistency: NO CONTRADICTION introduced. "NULL on single-tenant", "later release" and "18.1" occur nowhere in the branch file. "nullable tenant column" occurs only in the new text and in the unchanged D5 amendment ("a reserved nullable tenant column is the shape D1 forbids"), which still agrees with the amended D1 (NULL is not a state). "it has not shipped" survives in the D6 regime C note (item 3) and in the four D7 notes, and release-scope item 3 now says in so many words that those four describe stages 18.0.0 carries. The 2026-10-19 scope note's items 1 to 3 are explicitly re-read by the new release-scope note. D9's main text and the new exception note, and D8's main text and the residue note, are framed as rule plus recorded exception, which is what rulings `6328987873` (B not taken) and `6325596117` (Q1 A) decided.

### ② Semver level

No package changes; docs-only ADR text. No changeset is owed and the PR carries `skip-changeset`; `Clause-②: no`, `Metadata-protocol: none` are correct for a record of shipped behaviour. The gate expectation is Tier H landing by the maintainer, not a version bump.

### ③ Boundary flags

- B1 (not blocking; follow-up or fold-in): the D6 note of 2026-10-19 ("`sharing_rule` is charted under regime C … #24421 builds; it has not shipped") is stale on `origin/main`; it shipped in 18.0.0 through #24428 `964a23700f` and #24599 `1e8b6284c0` (item 3 above). The PR leaves that paragraph untouched and its body says so. A one-sentence fold-in to this PR, or a follow-up docs card, is the remedy.
- B2 (not blocking; wording precision in the D8 residue note): (a) `requireStartingOrganization` is asked at four sites, the commit, chunk and chunked-completion doors before their first write (`storage-routes.ts:992`, `:1166`, `:1308`) and the progress door when its expiry stamp is due (`:1416`); "three upload doors" follows the seat decision's count and is defensible if the progress door is read as a read door, but "four askers" would be exact. (b) "a database that has not been through the D10 ceremony, which `os serve` refuses at boot" is true of a v17 or pre-release store; an 18.0.0-born store is also one the ceremony never touched yet is served (certified at birth, nullable columns). The row still cannot reach it through `os serve`, because the storage doors ride the HTTP server that the no-auth and no-secret refusals gate, so the heading's "uncertified database only" stands; naming the refused class precisely would remove the ambiguity.
- B3 (not blocking; attribution precision in release-scope item 4): "7a-2, 7b-0 and 7b-1+7b-2 each pin that such a database boots on their head" cites `6291577585`, which states that requirement; the pin itself is #24911's fixture-18.0.0 harness leg (`81e6edd463`), on 7a-2's merged head but not added or reported run by #24872. Citing `6323222024` ("held on every merge, fixture-18.0.0 leg included") beside it, or saying "is held to", would make the sentence exact.
- B4 (pre-landing to-do, not a text fault): the two in-flight citations must become merge commits before landing, as the PR body and claim `6329368843` already undertake: the D9 note's boundary 2 (#25133's fix, ruling `6328987873`; its sentence "The refusal texts no longer offer `--no-server` as the remedy" describes the ruled state, and on `origin/main` today `serve.ts:4672` and `:4696` still offer it) and the D1 amendment's item 2 (#25134's `os migrate plan` advisory, ruling `6328195425`).
- B5 (seat process, not blocking for the text): the live PR reads `draft: false` (mergeable_state `blocked`, awaiting the approval) while its body and the claim say it "stays a draft, and is not enqueued, until #25133's fix and #25134's advisory have merged". Either the body is updated or the PR is converted back to draft until B4 is done; Tier H landing remains the maintainer's hand either way.
- B6 (nit): the new Status-line entry and the D1 Amended note cite record `6328195425` and letter A but do not quote the maintainer's words (「25134 … 同意」, in `6328195425`); the earlier amendments at D5 and in the two end-of-file sections quote them. Optional.
- Format: the seven new notes follow the file's `Note (date, record on card, letter) — title` blockquote convention of the 2026-10-19 notes; the D1 amendment follows the inline-amendment precedent at D5 (2026-10-16, #23385) with the original text quoted beside the replacement; the Status line's new `Amended (2026-10-22, #24897 — …)` entry follows the pattern of the two earlier entries (date, card, ruling letter and record, bold one-line effect) and, like the D5 precedent, has no end-of-file section to point at. The Status line's list of sections (D1, D2, D5, D7, D8, D9, D14) matches where the notes sit.
- Gates: `node scripts/check-adr-links.mjs` (770 links resolve), `node scripts/check-adr-anchors.mjs` and `node scripts/check-adr-symbol-anchors.mjs` (2380 anchors across 142 records resolve) each exit 0 on the head in a detached worktree; `check-docs-single-h1` exited 3 on a prerequisite, not a verdict. CI on `9b6e4da77e`: 30 check-runs succeeded and 10 skipped (latest per name), none failing or pending, including `Governed Surface Queue Guard`, `Check Documentation Links`, `Lint · docs & code guards`, `Lint · repo & tooling gates`, `Lint · PM dispatch-gates`, `TypeScript Type Check` and all six `Test Core` shards.
- Tier: `node scripts/pm/check-governed-merges.mjs --branch origin/claude/issue-24897-adr-0131-dated-notes` answers GOVERNED, landing tier H, `docs/adr/**` ×1, 202 changed lines (+176/-26), under the human-merge size threshold; head repo is `objectstack-ai/objectstack` (not a fork).

Implemented-by: `claude/issue-24897-adr-0131-dated-notes`
Reviewed-by: `session_01Y5583bs2RDd53MH6kM1ca3`

**VERDICT: PASS**
